howTo: Put each picture in this folder (public/assets/saga/) and write its file name below, then reload the board. A slot left as null keeps the built-in placeholder, and nothing is downloaded for it. Two pictures are still placeholders, half size with their names written on them: mr-saymaz-kneel.webp (Mr. Saymaz kneeling with his arms open, 640 × 1120, framed like his other poses) and hug.webp (the hug illustration, about 1600 × 900). The board skips a kneeling picture under 480 px wide and a hug picture under 1000 px wide and plays the hug with his other poses, so the real picture only has to replace the file under the same name.
